paper_sections.title: Study 2 ANOVA: Main effects and interactions

description.value: Two separate fMRI studies examined brain activity during expectancy of sexually relevant adult and child images in pedophilic sex offenders and healthy controls, focusing on differential dorsal anterior cingulate cortex activation.

spans.text: By including an expectancy period in a sexual information processing fMRI paradigm, we demonstrated differential activation patterns between PSOs and healthy control subjects in dACC, even before explicit sexual stimuli were actually presented.

description.value: Two separate cross-sectional, non-randomized studies used independent samples of pedophilic sex offenders and healthy controls.
